Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(CraftBench.L["Click to toggle favorite"], nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnLoad: self:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") self:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end
Scripts.OnHide: if self == CraftBench.mouseOver then if not InCombatLockdown() then CraftBenchFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end CraftBench.mouseOver = nil end
Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED" then if self == CraftBench.mouseOver then -- CraftBench:SkillButton_OnEnter(CraftBench.mouseOver) end if not InCombatLockdown() then if IsControlKeyDown() then CraftBenchFrame:EnableKeyboard(true) else CraftBenchFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end end end

Scripts.OnLoad: self:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") self:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end
Scripts.OnHide: if self == CraftBench.mouseOver then if not InCombatLockdown() then CraftBenchFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end CraftBench.mouseOver = nil if CraftBench.gttScale then GameTooltip:SetScale(CraftBench.gttScale) end GameTooltip:Hide() end
Scripts.OnLeave: self:UnregisterEvent("MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED") local ct = _G[self:GetName().."Counts"] local r,g,b = ct:GetTextColor() _G[self:GetName().."Name"]:SetTextColor(r, g, b) CraftBench.mouseOver = nil if CraftBench.gttScale then GameTooltip:SetScale(CraftBench.gttScale) end GameTooltip:Hide()
Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED" then if self == CraftBench.mouseOver then CraftBench:SkillButton_OnEnter(CraftBench.mouseOver) end if not InCombatLockdown() then if IsControlKeyDown() then CraftBenchFrame:EnableKeyboard(true) else CraftBenchFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end end end

Scripts.OnEditFocusLost: self:Hide() if (self.originalButton) then self.originalButton:Show() self.originalButton = nil CraftBench:UpdateTradeSkillWindow() end

Scripts.OnClick:
CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() if ( button == "LeftButton" and IsControlKeyDown() ) then
CraftBench:ReagentButtonControlClick(self, button, CraftBench.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) elseif ( button == "LeftButton" and IsShiftKeyDown() ) then
CraftBench:ReagentButtonShiftClick(self, button, CraftBench.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) elseif ( button == "RightButton" ) then CraftBench:ReagentButtonRightClick(self, button, CraftBench.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) else
CraftBench:ReagentButtonOnClick(self, button, CraftBench.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) end

Scripts.OnHide: if CraftBench.fullView then CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() CraftBench:CraftBenchFrameForceClose() end

Scripts.OnClick: CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(CraftBenchFilterDropMenu, CraftBench.InitializeFilterDropdown, "MENU") ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, CraftBenchFilterDropMenu, self, self:GetWidth(), 0)

Scripts.OnEditFocusGained: if IsAltKeyDown() then self:SetText("") else self:HighlightText() end

Scripts.OnVerticalScroll: CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() FauxScrollFrame_OnVerticalScroll(self, offset, CRAFTBENCH_TRADE_SKILL_HEIGHT, CraftBench.SkillList_OnScroll) -- re-apply the text highlight and tooltip (if any) when the button changes under the mouse on scroll event if CraftBench.mouseOver then CraftBench:SkillButton_OnEnter(CraftBench.mouseOver) end

Scripts.OnShow: local hideUncraftable = CraftBench:GetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable") C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowMakeableRecipes(hideUncraftable) if hideUncraftable then self:SetChecked(true) else self:SetChecked(false) end
Scripts.OnClick: if button=="LeftButton" then CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() if self:GetChecked() then PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_MAINMENU_OPTION_CHECKBOX_ON) -- "igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn" end local before = CraftBench:GetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable") CraftBench:SetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable", not before) C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowMakeableRecipes(not before) CraftBench:PrintTradeSkillFilter() CraftBench.dataScanned = false CraftBench:SortAndFilterRecipes() CraftBench:UpdateTradeSkillWindow() else if CraftBenchInventoryFilterBag:IsVisible() then CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() else CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Show() end if CraftBench:GetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable") then self:SetChecked(true) else self:SetChecked(false) end end
Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(CRAFT_IS_MAKEABLE_TOOLTIP, nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:AddLine(CraftBench.L["Left-Click to toggle"], .7, .7, .7) GameTooltip:AddLine(CraftBench.L["Right-Click for filtering options"], .7, .7, .7) GameTooltip:Show()
GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(PROFESSIONS_USE_BEST_QUALITY_REAGENTS, nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()
GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(PROFESSIONS_CRAFTING_CONCENTRATION_TOGGLE_ON_DESC, nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()
GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(CraftBench.L["Select skill difficulty threshold"], nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnClick: CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_MAINMENU_OPTION_CHECKBOX_ON) -- "igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn" local bottom = self:GetBottom() local top = self:GetTop() local x,y = GetCursorPosition() local scale = CraftBenchFrame:GetEffectiveScale() local newLevel = math.floor(4*(y/scale-bottom)/(top-bottom+1)+1) CraftBench:SetTradeSkillOption("filterLevel", newLevel) if newLevel > 1 then C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowSkillUpRecipes(true) else C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowSkillUpRecipes(false) end CraftBench:PrintTradeSkillFilter() self:Hide() CraftBenchRecipeDifficultyButton:Show() CraftBench.dataScanned = false CraftBench:SortAndFilterRecipes() CraftBench:UpdateTradeSkillWindow()

Scripts.OnClick:
CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() local link = CraftBench:GetRecipeItemLink(CraftBench.selectedSkill) if ( button == "LeftButton" and IsControlKeyDown() ) then
DressUpItemLink(link) elseif ( button == "LeftButton" and IsShiftKeyDown() ) then
if not ChatEdit_InsertLink(link) then CraftBench:XMLDebugLink("CraftBenchSkillIcon: link= ", link) end elseif ( button == "LeftButton" and IsAltKeyDown() ) then
CraftBench:ReagentsLinkOnClick(self, CraftBench.selectedSkill, self:GetID(), IsControlKeyDown()) elseif ( button == "RightButton" ) then
if ( IsShiftKeyDown() ) then CraftBench:AdjustNumberMade(CraftBench.selectedSkill,-1) else CraftBench:AdjustNumberMade(CraftBench.selectedSkill,1) end end
Scripts.OnEvent: if GameTooltip:IsVisible() and GameTooltip:IsOwned(self) then if ( CraftBench.selectedSkill ~= -1 ) then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") CraftBench:SetTradeSkillToolTip(CraftBenchFrame.selectedSkill) end end

Scripts.OnClick: CraftBench:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() if CraftBench:IsShoppingListVisible() then CraftBench:HideShoppingList() else CraftBench:DisplayShoppingList(false) end

Scripts.OnShow: PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_BACKPACK_OPEN) -- "igBackPackOpen" if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end
Scripts.OnHide: PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_BACKPACK_CLOSE) -- "igBackPackClose" if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end GameTooltip:Hide()
